notes.title: Game Update 1.1 Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Grog 1.1[/h1]
[h2]New Minigames and cosmetic items![/h2]
Hello once again Groggers, long time no see. Thanks for all the support and feedback. Here's a big new update for Grog that I hope everyone can enjoy. 

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added steam items, customisation, and inventory system
[*] Added third-person mode
[*] Added 4 more minigames: Home Improvements, Line waiting, Parkour, Upgrades.
[*] Improved decorations on all maps
[*] Added up to 8-player lobbies!
[*] Added 11 new achievements
[*] Added Steam rich presence in the friends menu
[*] Added Discord rich presence
[*] Added instructions menu
[/list]

[h2]Fixes and Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated networking code to new Steam API for security purposes
[*] Fixed friend achievements not being given
[*] Fixed some collision issues such as getting stuck on objects
[*] Fixed networking issues where certain player events such as punching weren't being sent to other players in the lobby
[*] Fixed water quality
[*] Fixed some settings not working
[*] Other small bugfixes
[/list]

Anyway, that's all for the new update, hope you all enjoy it. This will likely be the last big update to Grog. Thanks for playing, I've had fun developing Grog!

notes.title: Grog 1.0 has Officially Released!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Grog is now officially available to play, enjoy!

[h2]Minigames[/h2]
Grog 1.0 comes with 5 awesome minigames you can play with your friends!

[h3]BBQing[/h3]
Cook as much meat as possible within the time limit. Make sure you don't burn the meat though!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/8f3b162882571a99fe5940695d44a000b0e09c54.png[/img]

[h3]Lawnmowing[/h3]
Mow a lawn... More than the others
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/24db0fbacdafbf5119b56d74ac85819407ec7dd4.png[/img]

[h3]Beer Collecting[/h3]
You are in desperate need of some beer. Run around and collect any beer you can find before the other Dads find it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/1901e7295da770af6f8b9f02a9e856ee9a84adc9.png[/img]

[h3]Camping[/h3]
Collect important materials located around the map and improve your campsite before it's too dark!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/b89384587560537b39d0481ed1ddbd8c7d632798.png[/img]

[h3]Surfing[/h3]
Look back to your glory days and bring back your exceptional surfing skills. Use these old-school skills to stay in the water and avoid waves for as long as possible!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/0b931632633e7022324f2483c4342bf12dcbdb66.png[/img]

[h2]Customisation[/h2]
Customise parts of your dad to make him unique!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710266/d587f1921217df5d03a7370a08b382af92ebda84.png[/img]

Play now and live out your dreams of being an Australian dad! 

Thank you to all those who have play-tested Grog already, all feedback is appreciated!
